title: Highly Skilled Professional I
docsTitle: Required Documents for Highly Skilled Professional I
tips:
・HSP (i) visa is for **highly skilled professionals** in research, specialized/technical services, or business management

・Offers **preferential treatment** including multiple entry, spouse work permission, and faster PR eligibility

・Requires **minimum 70 points** based on education, experience, salary, age, and other factors

・Check the latest requirements at the [Immigration Services Agency](https://www.moj.go.jp/isa/)
